description: List funding for an ORCID researcher, or supply a summary putCode as put_code to fetch one deposited award. Summary returns one preferred record per grant group with all sources and distinct periods. Detail returns that deposit alone with its own source, optional exact decimal amount and currency, URL, and deposited description. Continue description text by passing nextDescriptionOffset as description_offset with the same put_code; offsets count Unicode code points. Complete detail surfaces fit 64,000 bytes, with explicit metadata or single-code-point overflow exceptions. Funding records are sparse; absence does not imply no funding.

description_offset.description: Unicode code-point offset into the deposited description, default 0; requires put_code.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

put_code.description: Selected deposit putCode from a funding summary. Omit to list grouped summaries.

name: orcid_get_funding

budgetOverflow.description: Explicit exception when metadata or one indivisible code point exceeds the 64,000-byte detail budget.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `detail_required`: description_offset is provided without a funding selector. `funding_not_found`: The selected funding deposit is unavailable at this ORCID iD. `funding_inaccessible`: ORCID denies public access to the selected funding deposit. `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

funding.description: Funding group summaries or one selected funding deposit.

items.description: One preferred funding group summary or the selected deposit detail.

amount.description: Deposited amount and currency; missing values are not inferred.

value.description: Exact deposited decimal text; no numeric conversion.

description.description: Exact deposited description page, including its original line endings.

descriptionLength.description: Full deposited description length in Unicode code points.

descriptionOffset.description: Starting Unicode code-point offset of this description page.

endDate.description: Funding end date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated funder identifier (e.g. Crossref Funder ID URL or ROR URL).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of funder disambiguation (FUNDREF, ROR, GRID, etc.).

grantNumbers.description: Grant numbers or award identifiers for this funding record.

nextDescriptionOffset.description: First omitted code point; pass as description_offset with the same put_code.

periods.description: Every distinct award period the funding item's versions record, ordered by start date — present only when there are two or more, such as renewals under one grant number. The other fields come from ORCID's preferred version.

items.description: Award period one version of this funding item records.

endDate.description: Period end date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

startDate.description: Period start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

putCode.description: Preferred summary or selected deposit put-code; pass as put_code for detail.

sources.description: The parties that added the funding item: every distinct group source in summary, the selected deposit's own source in detail. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the requested ORCID iD; false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

startDate.description: Funding start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: Funding type (e.g. grant, contract, award, salary-award).

url.description: URL for the funding record, if available.

fundingCount.description: Number of funding items returned: one per group in summary, one deposit in detail.

notice.description: Note when no funding is found — absence of records does not mean absence of funding.

view.description: Grouped summaries or one selected deposit.

title: Get ORCID Researcher Funding
